newsitem.title: UK: Partial eclipse lost to most Britons behind clouds.
newsitem.headline: Partial eclipse lost to most Britons behind clouds.

text.p: The largest partial eclipse of the sun over Britain for 35 years took place on Saturday, but in typical English fashion the weather was too cloudy for most people to see it.
The skies cleared for about two hours over London and the south-east corner of Britain as the moon blotted out about half of the sun.
But the partial eclipse, described by astronomers as the biggest over Britain since 1961, was hidden behind heavy grey skies in the rest of the country.
